raw.details:
InnovaThon – Hackathon 2026

Organized by the Faculty of Engineering and Technology (FET), Agra College × NIMBLUX

About the Opportunity:

InnovaThon is an innovation-driven hackathon designed to bring together passionate students, developers, designers, and aspiring entrepreneurs to solve real-world problems through technology and creative thinking.

Organized collaboratively by the Faculty of Engineering and Technology, Agra College, and NIMBLUX, this event provides participants with an opportunity to showcase their technical skills, collaborate with like-minded innovators, build practical solutions, and turn their ideas into impactful projects.

Whether you are interested in Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, App Development, FinTech, Cybersecurity, Healthcare, Education, Sustainability, or emerging technologies, InnovaThon encourages you to think beyond conventional solutions and build something meaningful.

Join the Official WhatsApp Community

Get event updates, important announcements, round details, and other hackathon information through our WhatsApp community.

Join here: https://chat.whatsapp.com/EE0KsRCJqKRKEy1XTNTHca

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Open to college students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate programs.
  • Students from engineering, computer science, management, and other academic disciplines are welcome.
  • Beginners and first-time hackathon participants are encouraged to apply.
  • Participants may register individually or in teams, subject to the official registration guidelines.
  • All participants must provide accurate information during registration.

Themes and Problem Statements:

Participants may develop innovative solutions in areas such as:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Web and Mobile Application Development
  • Cybersecurity and Digital Safety
  • Education Technology and Skill Development
  • Healthcare and Social Impact
  • FinTech and Digital Innovation
  • Smart Cities, Sustainability, and Green Technology
  • Open Innovation: solutions addressing real-world challenges

Participation Process:

  • Register: Complete the registration process through the official event registration page.
  • Choose a Problem: Select an announced problem statement or propose an idea aligned with the event themes, subject to organizer approval.
  • Build Your Solution: Develop a working prototype, application, or technical proof of concept during the hackathon period.
  • Submit Your Project: Submit the required project materials, including a project description, presentation, source code or repository link, and demonstration where applicable.
  • Evaluation: Projects will be reviewed by the evaluation panel based on innovation, technical implementation, feasibility, impact, and presentation.
  • Results: Winners will be announced through the official communication channels.

Rules and Guidelines:

  • Participants must submit original work and respect intellectual property rights.
  • Previously developed components and open-source tools may be used where permitted, but existing projects must not be misrepresented as newly developed work.
  • AI tools and third-party libraries may be used responsibly. Participants should disclose significant external contributions when requested.
  • Plagiarism, copied submissions, fraudulent information, and unfair practices may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must follow the official submission deadlines and instructions.
  • Teams are responsible for ensuring their submitted projects function as described.
  • Organizers reserve the right to verify submissions, clarify rules, and disqualify participants who violate the guidelines.
  • Decisions made by the evaluation panel regarding the competition results will be final.

Evaluation Criteria:

Projects may be evaluated on the following criteria:

  • Innovation and originality
  • Technical implementation and functionality
  • Problem relevance and practical feasibility
  • Potential impact and scalability
  • User experience and presentation quality

Project Submission Requirements

Participants should be prepared to submit:

  • Project title and problem statement
  • Solution overview and key features
  • Working prototype or demonstration
  • Source code or repository link, where applicable
  • Presentation or project documentation
  • Team details, if participating as a team

Why Participate?

  • Showcase your innovation and technical skills.
  • Gain practical experience in problem-solving and product development.
  • Collaborate with students and technology enthusiasts.
  • Strengthen your project portfolio.
  • Earn recognition for outstanding solutions.
  • Explore opportunities to connect with the broader technology community.

Important Information:

The official registration page and organizer announcements will serve as the authoritative source for confirmed dates, team-size limits, participation format, submission deadlines, prizes, certificates, and other event-specific conditions.

Build. Innovate. Collaborate. Make an Impact.

Join InnovaThon and turn your ideas into solutions for tomorrow.

Organizers: Faculty of Engineering and Technology, Agra College × NIMBLUX
